evidence: Adopted programme fractions and transition requirements. The fractions set planning targets; they do not measure site feasibility, construction rate or supported population.
denominator: All catalogue detections in the inclusive 200–1,000 m diameter range, before geometry, water, climate and location exclusions.
initial_enclosure: One contiguous dome over a complete community, with its eventual lifestyle and layout substantially in place. Subdivision is an option for larger settlements.
technology_scope: Existing engineering and materials together with reasonably confident improvements already under development. Record their evidence and distinguish projected component performance from a qualified complete design.
end_state: Domeless communities after a sustainable breathable atmosphere is established; remove the pressure enclosures.
requirements: Choose geometry and location for both long vacuum operation and the completed Open Moon.
Provide fully functional, efficient communities through a potentially long vacuum period, without assuming an opening date.
Plan travel and freight between communities throughout the airless period.
Design enclosure structure, services and removal for the changing loads of atmospheric transition.
supersedes: The earlier 20,000–100,000-site abundance scenario as the current buildout target; its assumptions and history remain in design.json and the decisions register.
reading_rule: Multiply each fraction by the same size-limited catalogue count and round down. Initial sites belong to the eventual set; the two counts are not additive. Geometry rankings, enclosure construction, operational loads and transport designs require study and site assessment.
